notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary!
notes.notes:
It's been around one year since the launch of Nilspace and we just wanted to thank everyone who supported us and played the game!

We spent many years working on the game as a passion project and wanted to create something that would "scratch the itch" of Strategy RPG games while offering something for different kinds of players. We're glad to see that the overall experience of the game was well received for the quality we were able to put into the game. 

We have appreciated the feedback and kind words from various places online and always enjoy hearing from the community.

Thank you!
